name: Gimbal
author: Sven Mathieu
description: Tablet mode for the Framework Laptop 12 on Omarchy: rotation, an on-screen keyboard that appears when you tap a text field and works inside the menu, two thumb knobs for gestures, and a keypad on the lock screen. fcitx5 is left alone.

barWidget.description: Tablet gestures, on-screen keyboard and rotation settings.
